newsitem.title: MEXICO: Quake shakes southern Mexico, no injuries reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake shakes southern Mexico, no injuries reported.

text.p: An earthquake shook two states on Mexico's southwestern coast on Saturday, but there were no initial reports of damage or injuries, officials said.
The quake, which took place at 9:22 a.m. local time (1422 GMT), registered 6.3 on the Richter scale, authorities at the National Autonomous University of Mexico's monitoring centre said.
Mexico's National Disaster Committee said the quake shook the states of Guerrero and Oaxaca, on Mexico's Pacific coast.
"There are no reports of any injuries or any damage, thank goodness," a National Disaster Committee spokesman said.
Last May, an earthquake that Mexican authorities said measured 5.9 on the Richter scale damaged 60 percent of houses in the city of Artega, in the state of Michoacan that neighbours Guerrero.
